Project Summary: AstroHealth – Smart Health Monitoring System for Astronauts During Space Missions
AstroHealth is a smart health monitoring system designed to monitor astronauts' health conditions during space missions. It collects important health parameters such as heart rate, blood pressure, body temperature, oxygen saturation (SpO₂), and respiratory rate.

The system uses Python, FastAPI, MySQL, and Machine Learning to store and analyze health data. It automatically detects abnormal health conditions, generates emergency alerts, and sends real-time notifications to mission control through WebSocket communication. It also provides health history, medical reports, and health risk predictions.

Main Objective: To improve astronaut safety by continuously monitoring their health, identifying potential health risks early, and helping mission control take timely action.

Expected Outcome: A secure and user-friendly health monitoring platform that supports real-time health tracking, automatic abnormality detection, emergency alerts, and data-driven health risk analysis during space missions.
details:
AstroHealth – Smart Health Monitoring System for Astronauts During Space Missions

1. Project Overview:
AstroHealth is a smart web-based application designed to monitor astronauts' health conditions during space missions and improve their safety.

2. Problem Statement:
Astronauts may experience health risks due to microgravity, radiation and isolation. Manual health monitoring can delay the detection of abnormal conditions.

3. Main Objectives:

  • Monitor astronauts' vital health parameters.
  • Detect abnormal health conditions automatically.
  • Generate emergency alerts.
  • Provide real-time health updates to mission control.
  • Predict potential health risks using Machine Learning.

4. Key Features:

  • Heart rate monitoring.
  • Blood pressure monitoring.
  • Body temperature monitoring.
  • SpO₂ monitoring.
  • Respiratory rate monitoring.
  • Emergency alert generation.
  • Health history and medical reports.
  • Health risk prediction.

5. Technologies Used:

  • Frontend: HTML, CSS, JavaScript
  • Backend: Python, FastAPI
  • Database: MySQL
  • ORM: SQLAlchemy
  • Authentication: JWT
  • Real-time communication: WebSocket
  • Machine Learning: Scikit-learn

6. Expected Outcome:
A secure and user-friendly health monitoring platform that helps track astronauts' health, identify potential risks early and support timely medical responses during space missions.

7. Future Scope:
Integration with wearable health sensors, advanced AI prediction, mobile applications and secure communication with space mission control.
